description: Abstract class providing functionality for comparison operations within the Apache OFBiz mini-language framework. Defines methods for performing comparisons, constructing objects from XML elements, and handling comparison parameters such as operator, type, and format.

classes.name: BaseCompare
classes.description: An abstract class that provides comparison functionalities for mini-language operations in OFBiz. Handles configuration and execution of comparison logic.

methods.name: doRealCompare
methods.description: Performs a comparison between two objects based on specified operator, type, format, and other parameters, utilizing ObjectType utility.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Executes the comparison and adds a message if the comparison fails.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Placeholder method to execute the operation, overridden in subclasses.
